verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships a built-in AI Helpbot, opened in-app with cmd/ctrl + K. But it is documented only as answering questions from approved support and documentation content, so delegation is limited to clarification-style help, not executing work in the workspace. In-workspace action is documented only through the MCP server, which serves an external AI assistant rather than a built-in one, and First Pass AI and GenAI DDQ autofill are fixed automations, not an assistant you hand tasks to. Missing for 10: a built-in assistant that takes delegated actions inside the workspace (e.g., updating evidence requests or controls), multi-step task execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The AI Helpbot is designed to assist users by answering questions based on approved Thoropass support and documentation content.
You can also open the bot with a cmd/ctrl + K keyboard shortcut!
Customers typically use the Assistant to: Clarify Thoropass workflows and best practices, Understand compliance framework requirements (SOC, PCI, HITRUST, etc.)
